_note: DEMO / SIMULATED DATA — Infrastructure locations are approximate, for demonstration only.

hospitals.name: SCB Medical College & Hospital, Cuttack
hospitals.notes: State's premier trauma centre. Within 34-kt wind radius.

hospitals.name: MKCG Medical College, Berhampur
hospitals.notes: Southern Odisha's referral hospital. High wind exposure.

hospitals.name: District HQ Hospital, Puri
hospitals.notes: Inside critical surge zone. Patient transfer recommended.

hospitals.name: District Hospital Kendrapara
hospitals.notes: At risk from Mahanadi delta flooding.

hospitals.name: AIIMS Bhubaneswar
hospitals.notes: High-capacity referral centre with full backup power.

hospitals.name: Capital Hospital, Bhubaneswar
hospitals.notes: Outside main impact zone. Receiving point for transfers.

hospitals.name: District Hospital Jagatsinghpur
hospitals.notes: Within Devi river surge penetration risk corridor.

shelters.name: Konark Cyclone Shelter
shelters.notes: Within critical zone. Elevated structure provides surge protection.

shelters.name: Bhubaneswar Sports Complex Shelter
shelters.notes: Inland mega shelter. Receiving inland evacuees.

powerSubstations.name: Chilikadar 220kV Substation
powerSubstations.notes: Critical node supplying Puri and Chilika coast. No backup routing.

powerSubstations.name: Bhubaneswar 220kV Grid Station
powerSubstations.notes: City grid hub. Backup routing via Talcher line.

powerSubstations.name: Berhampur 132kV Substation
powerSubstations.notes: Southern grid feed. Exposed to direct wind impact.

powerSubstations.name: Paradeep Port Grid
powerSubstations.notes: Industrial port zone. Surge flood risk to switchyard.

powerSubstations.name: Cuttack 220kV Substation
powerSubstations.notes: North grid hub. Wind speed within operating limit at current track.

powerSubstations.name: Phulbani 132kV Substation
powerSubstations.notes: Inland station. Low direct impact expected.

bridges.name: Devi River Bridge (NH-316B)
bridges.notes: Aging structure over surge-prone Devi river mouth. Critical evacuation route.

bridges.name: Chilika Causeway
bridges.notes: Causeway across Chilika lagoon. Surge overtopping risk high.

bridges.name: Mahanadi Barrage Road Bridge
bridges.notes: River barrage crossing. Elevated but exposed to flood discharge.

bridges.name: Paradeep Approach Bridge
bridges.notes: Port access route. Surge risk if sea pushes back.

bridges.name: Subarnarekha River Bridge
bridges.notes: Northern boundary bridge. Within outer wind bands.

bridges.name: Brahmani River Road Bridge
bridges.notes: Delta crossing. Risk from Brahmani river surge pulse.

roads.name: NH-316 — Puri to Konark
roads.notes: Primary coastal corridor. Surge inundation risk at multiple low-lying sections.

roads.name: NH-16 — Bhubaneswar to Berhampur
roads.notes: Main evacuation artery. Wind damage to overhead lines possible.

roads.name: SH-17 — Puri to Satapada (Chilika)
roads.notes: Chilika coastal road. Prone to surge overtopping.

roads.name: NH-53 — Cuttack to Paradeep
roads.notes: Industrial port access. Partial flooding risk in delta sections.

roads.name: Coastal Route — Kendrapara
roads.notes: Low-lying delta road. High inundation probability.

roads.name: NH-16 — Bhubaneswar to Cuttack
roads.notes: Main north-south artery. Wind damage minor.

roads.name: Berhampur — Ganjam Coast Road
roads.notes: Southern coastal road. Peripheral surge risk.

schools.name: Puri Zilla High School
schools.notes: Low-lying school near coastline. Designated secondary community evacuation point.

schools.name: Konark Model High School
schools.notes: Directly exposed to onshore surge. Classes suspended; ground floor flood vulnerability.

schools.name: Kendrapara Government College
schools.notes: Large educational complex. Elevated multistory building can shelter up to 1,500 evacuees.

schools.name: Jagatsinghpur Central Secondary
schools.notes: Devi river delta backwater flood prone. Precautionary asset hardening needed.

schools.name: Ravenshaw Collegiate School, Cuttack
schools.notes: Historic inland campus. High wind exposure but elevated above river flood stage.

schools.name: Bhubaneswar Public School
schools.notes: Inland elevated school. Operational relief staging and supply depot.

communicationTowers.name: Puri Marine Drive Telecom Tower
communicationTowers.notes: Primary coastal cellular mast. Extreme wind shear threat and surge inundation risk to base station.

communicationTowers.name: Konark Shoreline Cellular Node
communicationTowers.notes: Shoreline microwave relay node. High risk of structural mast fatigue in >200 km/h wind gusts.

communicationTowers.name: Chilika Coastal Relay Mast
communicationTowers.notes: Critical link connecting Chilika fishing communities to state emergency dispatch.

communicationTowers.name: Paradeep Port Telecom Tower
communicationTowers.notes: Hardened port communication tower. Maritime radio and radar transponders active.

communicationTowers.name: Kendrapara Delta Relay Tower
communicationTowers.notes: Low-lying base station generator prone to floodwater ingress.

communicationTowers.name: Chandaka Hill VHF/UHF Relay
communicationTowers.notes: Elevated strategic state radio relay. Zero surge risk; equipped with heavy-duty backup power.
